description: The fleet's Renovate run (StartupBros-com/home-infrastructure, renovate-config.js) sets the schedule, PR limits, release-age floors and automerge. This file adds only what this repository needs. Dependabot keeps the GitHub Actions bumps (.github/dependabot.yml), as everywhere in the fleet.

packageRules.description: The Bun runtime moves by hand, in .bun-version, the Dockerfile, package.json and this file's constraints together (docs/contributing.md, "Bumping the Bun toolchain"). Renovate names those pins bun, oven/bun (the Dockerfile image) and oven-sh/bun (constraints.bun, a GitHub release).
